redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production conformance only.
Public official pages or documents retained as validation receipts; visibility does not imply bulk extraction or public-serving rights.
Exact Lantmäteriet valuable-data address delivery under CC BY 4.0 and the purpose, personal-data, geography, storage, security, attribution and decision conditions approved for that delivery.
Purchased or subscription data licensed for the customer's organization; resale, sublicensing and public serving remain prohibited absent separate written permission.
Credentialed, approval-gated, failed-download or unclear-rights material used only as specifically permitted and never promoted by assumption.
Personal, ownership, customer or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.production_scope: PTS states that postcodes exist only to route mail, need not follow districts, municipalities or counties, and are administered by appointed PostNord with PTS approval for larger changes.

The current public lookup and operator guidance may verify individual addresses or current change timing. Standard public GET was blocked by Cloudflare during this audit; no bypass, automation or bulk query was attempted.

PTS links the 2017 fact sheet. Indexed text distinguishes ordinary delivery codes from poste-restante, P.O.-box, reply/freepost, competition-mail and large-customer codes and says a large-customer code does not specify exact geographic location. Standard GET returned Cloudflare 403, so no exact PDF body was fixed.

Postnummerservice advertises quality-controlled address, postcode and geodata updated weekly and sourced through national postal operators, land survey agencies and official authorities. An indexed 2026 price PDF lists Swedish five-digit postcode surfaces, but no product delivery was purchased or acquired.
The current terms grant a licence to use purchased data within the organization and expressly prohibit resale and sublicensing to third parties. No purchase or separate permission occurred.

The product provides municipality-partitioned INSPIRE address data with postcode/post town, GML delivery, EPSG:3006 or 4258 and half-year updates. Ordering yields a login and use requires legal purpose review and special terms approval.

Terms version 1.1 dated 2025-03-04 permits CC BY 4.0 use and modification with attribution and processed-data disclosure, while personal data may be processed only for the purpose stated in the application and approved by Lantmäteriet, with geographic necessity and storage conditions.

artifact_partitions.rule: PTS/PostNord roles, five-digit text, source purpose, capture time and exact assignment semantics remain independently auditable.
Product identity, delivery, method, edition, CRS, schema, rights, digest, coverage, topology and exceptions must be fixed; listing or price never substitutes for the artifact or permission.
Lantmäteriet address identity, PostNord attributes, Point geometry, purpose approval, fields, date, terms and digest remain separate from postal-area authority.
Only exact source areas or reproducible complete-membership derivations may be published, with official/derived class, gaps, conflicts, exclusions, rights, topology, uncertainty and lineage.
P.O.-box, poste-restante, reply/freepost, competition-mail, large-customer, organization, route and unmatched codes remain explicit non-areas absent exact source geometry.
Address, building, parcel and explicit address-building relation remain distinct; protected fields never enter public artifacts.
Municipal/administrative geometry, postal coverage and territorial identity remain separate and never infer one another.
Recipients, residents, owners, contacts, credentials and protected property records never enter public artifacts.
Non-geographic test evidence only; never promotion evidence.
